description: Search catalog rule of the store's catalog (ZnodeSearchCatalogRule, not paused, in its dates) whose trigger keyword boosts (item boost value above 1: listed first) or buries (below 1: listed last) one product by SKU. Outputs: keyword, productName, productSku. Read only.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

ruleEffect.description: boost (product listed first) or bury (product listed last)

keyword.description: Trigger keyword the rule must match, e.g. @boost.keyword so a bury rule shares the boost search. Left out: any
